name: How important is flood insurance in Fort Lauderdale?

mainEntity.name: How important is flood insurance in Fort Lauderdale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flood insurance is highly important in Fort Lauderdale, as much of the area is at or near sea level and susceptible to flooding, especially during hurricane season or heavy rains. While federally backed mortgages in designated flood zones require it, even properties outside these zones may benefit from coverage due to potential risks. FEMA flood maps determine requirements, but local conditions can vary. Our team can help you identify if a specific property is in a flood zone and guide you on understanding insurance needs relevant to Broward County properties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flood insurance is crucial in Fort Lauderdale due to flood susceptibility, especially in designated flood zones or during hurricane season.
